title: Hydrania the Hundred-Headed
story: Deep in the Misty Marsh, Mr 6 faces Hydrania the Hydra. Every time he slices off one of her heads, 3 new heads grow back in its place! Hydrania has 4 heads right now, and Mr 6 swings his sword twice before realizing something is very wrong.
question: After Mr 6 slices off one head, and then another, how many heads glare down at him?
hint: Take it one swing at a time. Start with 4: take away 1, then add 3. Now do it again with your new number.
victory: Eight heads! Mr 6 sheathes his sword and instead tosses Hydrania a wheel of the village's famous cheese. It turns out hydras just get grumpy when they're hungry — she happily slithers home.
